meta.home_title: Sparkfall Games — Indie games & honest iOS apps
meta.home_desc: Sparkfall Games is a one-person indie studio making playful games and honest, private iOS tools. No accounts, no servers, no tracking.

hero.title: Playful games. Honest tools.
hero.subtitle: Every title is built solo and private by design — your data stays on your device. No accounts, no servers, no tracking.

values.private_desc: Everything is stored on your device. We don't run servers and can't see your data.
values.honest_desc: Free tiers stay free forever. No subscription traps, no fake countdowns.
values.global_desc: Every app is fully localized in 34 languages, with dark mode and accessibility support.

common.coming_soon: Coming soon to the App Store

quickcost.card_desc: A minimal expense tracker that keeps every record on your iPhone.
quickcost.subtitle: A minimal, private expense tracker for iPhone. Open, tap, done — in 3 seconds.
quickcost.meta_desc: QuickCost is a minimal expense tracker for iPhone. Log an expense in 3 seconds. All data stays on your device.

features.d: Open the app, tap the amount and a category — your expense is saved.
No account, no server. Your financial records never leave your iPhone.
Daily, monthly and category summaries show where your money goes.
Fully localized worldwide, with dark mode and large-type support.

quickcost.privacy_blurb: QuickCost stores everything locally on your device and collects nothing.

decibelmeter.tagline: Know your noise. Protect your hearing.
decibelmeter.card_desc: Real-time sound level meter with a daily noise dose tracker.
decibelmeter.subtitle: A real-time sound level meter with a daily noise dose tracker that helps protect your hearing.
decibelmeter.meta_desc: Decibel Meter measures sound levels in real time and tracks your daily noise dose. Audio never leaves your iPhone.

features.d: Real-time dB readout with MIN, AVG and MAX at a glance.
Tracks your exposure against the NIOSH 85 dB / 8 h guideline.
Audio is analyzed in real time and never stored or uploaded.
Start and stop measuring from your Home Screen or hands-free.

decibelmeter.privacy_blurb: All analysis happens on your device. No audio is ever recorded or uploaded.
decibelmeter.disclaimer: Noise dose figures are general reference information, not a medical measurement.

fastzen.card_desc: An intermittent fasting timer with no subscription traps.
fastzen.subtitle: An honest intermittent fasting timer. The free tier is complete — forever.
fastzen.meta_desc: FastZen is an honest intermittent fasting tracker. Core features free forever; Pro via monthly, yearly, or lifetime. Fully private. No ads.

features.d: All preset plans, the timer, history, streaks and notifications are free.
Custom goals and insights via monthly, yearly (7-day trial when eligible), or lifetime. Free forever stays complete. No ads.
See the phases commonly associated with each hour of your fast.
No account, no server — your fasting history stays on your device.

fastzen.privacy_blurb: Your fasting history never leaves your iPhone.
fastzen.disclaimer: FastZen is a timer and logging tool, not medical advice. Consult a healthcare professional before starting any fasting practice.

numzen.tagline: Three daily puzzles. The whole world plays.
numzen.card_desc: Daily mental math puzzles with hints that teach.
numzen.subtitle: Daily mental math puzzles — the same challenge for everyone worldwide, with hints that teach instead of spoil.
numzen.meta_desc: NumZen serves daily number puzzles — the same challenge for everyone worldwide, with hints that teach. Fully offline and private.

features.d: Everyone in the world gets the same puzzles each day — fully offline.
Strategy tips and a single next step, never the full solution.
The daily challenge and 5 practice puzzles per day are always free.
Unlimited practice puzzles, yours forever. No subscription.

numzen.privacy_blurb: NumZen works entirely offline and collects nothing.

mergehold.card_desc: A merge tactics defense duel across the Three Kingdoms and beyond.
mergehold.subtitle: Merge heroes, forge gear and out-plan a mirrored rival wave by wave — from the Three Kingdoms to ancient Egypt and warring Fusang.
mergehold.meta_desc: Mergehold is a merge tactics defense duel for iPhone: build your board, merge heroes and hold your castle against a mirrored rival. Three historic eras. No loot boxes.

features.d: You and your rival face the same waves on the same map — pure planning, no luck.
Three Kingdoms, ancient Egypt and Fusang — each with its own heroes, gear and talents.
Merge cards into stronger heroes, pick talents and trigger faction synergies.
Cosmetics and era passes only — power is never for sale, and there are no loot boxes.

mergehold.privacy_blurb: Matches run on your device and Game Center. We run no servers and collect nothing.

gloomfall.card_desc: A dark fantasy tactics RPG built for one hand.
gloomfall.subtitle: A dark fantasy tactics RPG where every enemy attack is telegraphed — no hit chances, no dice. Build your keep, mourn your dead.
gloomfall.meta_desc: Gloomfall is a dark fantasy tactics RPG for iPhone: deterministic 7×7 battles, branching expeditions, permadeath and a keep to build. Fully offline and private.

features.d: Every enemy shows where it will strike. Outplay it — no dice, no excuses.
Battles, events, merchants and camps across three regions and the endless Abyss.
Six classes, 36 skills, rolled gear — and a memorial wall for the fallen.
Region one, three classes and the daily expedition are free forever. One purchase unlocks the rest.

gloomfall.privacy_blurb: Gloomfall works entirely offline and collects nothing.

overlens.tagline: See any screen in your language.
overlens.card_desc: Live on-screen translation for games, apps and images — fully on-device.
overlens.subtitle: A floating window that live-translates games, apps and images on your screen — entirely on your device.
overlens.meta_desc: OverLens live-translates the text on your screen with a floating window, plus free unlimited screenshot translation. 100% on-device, no upload.

features.d: Start once, switch to any game or app, and translations follow you.
Pick or paste an image — the translation appears right on top. Free, unlimited.
Language packs download once. Your screen never leaves the device.
No subscription, no coins. Free daily live time, one honest unlock.

overlens.privacy_blurb: Text recognition and translation run entirely on your device. Nothing is recorded, stored or uploaded.

packnest.card_desc: Smart packing lists built from your trip, weather and activities.
packnest.subtitle: PackNest builds your packing list from the trip itself — days, climate and activities — so nothing gets left behind.
packnest.meta_desc: PackNest generates smart packing lists from your destination, dates and activities. Multiple bags and travelers, PDF export, fully offline.

features.d: Tell it the days, climate and activities — get a complete list in seconds.
Split items across suitcases and family members, and check off together.
Keep a reusable kit of essentials that drops into every new trip.
24 region guides built in. Your trips stay on your device.

packnest.privacy_blurb: Your trips and lists stay on your device. Optional weather uses Apple's WeatherKit.

sections.games_sub: Original games built to respect you — no ads between levels, no energy timers, no paywalled fun.
sections.tools_sub: Small, sharp utilities that stay out of your way — and out of your data.

teaser.desc: Something is warming up backstage. The curtain rises soon.

about.title: About the developer
about.body: I'm the solo developer behind Sparkfall Games. Every game and tool is 100% native to iOS, localized in 34 languages, and built around one rule: your data stays on your device.
